title: Skeleton
overview: Placeholder geometry that matches the final layout so the page does not jump when content arrives.
apply_when: Feeds, card grids, dashboards, tables whose shape is known.
not_when: A spinner with no layout (loading_indicator), empty finished state (empty_state), or step chrome (progress).

vs.why: indeterminate wait graphic, not layout stand-in
there is no data, not still loading

role.overview: Placeholder geometry that matches the final layout so the page does not jump when content arrives.
role.apply_when: Feeds, card grids, dashboards, tables whose shape is known.
role.not_when: A spinner with no layout (loading_indicator), empty finished state (empty_state), or step chrome (progress).

size.overview: Highest in the size hierarchy — the easiest to hit.
size.apply_when: The view's main instance, or full-width on a small viewport.
size.not_when: A dense toolbar or a third option next to the main control.

size.apply_when: Ordinary use in forms, pages, and chrome.
size.not_when: The only control on a mobile screen that should span the width.

size.overview: Lowest in the size hierarchy — densest.
size.apply_when: Inline or chrome that sits beside content.
size.not_when: The page's primary instance, or a control under 44×44.

composition.overview: Blocks match the heading, image, and text that will arrive.
composition.not_when: A generic grey box that does not match the result.

state.overview: Content has not arrived. This is not empty.
state.apply_when: First paint of a known layout.

accessibility.overview: The region is exposed as busy / loading, not as the final content.
accessibility.not_when: Fake titles that AT reads as real data.

accessibility.overview: This is not announced as no results.
accessibility.not_when: An empty_state copy on a skeleton.

keyboard.overview: The skeleton is not a set of fake tab stops.
keyboard.not_when: Placeholder buttons in the tab order.
